blurb: Westport Golf Club is the Charlotte area’s best value in golf. Located in Denver, Westport offers a great annual membership plan and affordable daily fee rates to the golfing public. Only 20 minutes from downtown Charlotte, Westport is at the top of the list of “must play” courses in the area.
